title: TELL, DON’T SHOW: DECLARATIVE FACTS INFLUENCE HOW LLMS GENERALIZE

bias_targets.methodology: The researchers fine-tuned models on datasets with constructed correlations between teacher gender and nationality (e.g., European teachers being 80% male vs. African teachers being 80% female) and measured the models' probability of generating male vs. female teacher profiles for held-out countries to test if declarative statements could override these statistical patterns.
